judgement.reason: changedetection.io keeps all its watches, history and settings in a local datastore directory with no database option, and Deployz provides no persistent disk.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume changedetection-data:/datastore (docker-compose.yml changedetection)
reviews.reason: The production start command passes -d /datastore as the data directory, and no shown setting moves the watches and their history to PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis or S3, so the app needs durable local storage.
